title: Dynamics of integer zeroes of homogeneous quadratic equations over $\mathbb{R}^3$
summary: Romik has presented a construction of a 1-dimensional dynamical system on the unit interval by developing an algorithm that returns the unique sequence of matrices associated with a positive primitive Pythagorean triple (in the sense of Barning), and projecting the map involved in this algorithm onto an appropriate 1-dimensional space via stereographic projection. Romik additionally computes the infinite, absolutely continuous invariant measure, and shows that the system is conservative and ergodic.
